description: Find recurring subscriptions, duplicate charges, price increases and trial-conversion suspects in recorded expenses, optionally by cost (e.g. over $20/month). Returns message/data with recurring, duplicates, priceIncreases, trialConversions, totalMonthlyCost and sampleMeta.

dateRange.description: Requested period; YYYY year; inclusive YYYY-MM-DD bounds.

focus.description: Narrow the audit to a single category (default: all)

query.description: Natural language subscription question (e.g., 'find duplicate subscriptions', 'price increases this year')

name: get_subscription_audit

success.description: Present only on the error branch (out of scope) / async path.
